title: PublicToilet
description: One public toilet: one row of the list a municipality publishes as 自治体標準オープンデータセット dataset 13 (公衆トイレ一覧), with the numbers of toilets by kind

@context.description: JSON-LD context of the entity, optional: a context URL or a list of context URLs

nameKana.description: Name in full-width katakana (名称_カナ)

nameEn.description: Name in English (名称_英字 or 名称_英語)

externalFacilityId.description: The facility's ID in the municipality's list (ID; unique within the municipality and the dataset). Together with localGovernmentCode it identifies the facility nationwide

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code of the municipality that publishes the list (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits)

address.description: Address of the facility, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject). Its localGovernmentCode is the code of the municipality the facility lies in, which can differ from the publisher's

location.description: Where the facility is, as a point (緯度, 経度)

installationLocation.description: Where the toilet is, for example at which exit of a station (設置位置). The dataset identifies a toilet by name and installation location

operatorName.description: Name of the organisation that runs the facility or, for equipment such as an AED, installed it (団体名, 法人の名称)

corporateNumber.description: Corporate number (法人番号, 13 digits, National Tax Agency) of the organisation that runs the facility or installed the equipment

contactPoint.description: How to get in touch, as a ContactPoint value (common subject): telephone, extension, fax, e-mail, web form, other channels, postal code

openingHoursSpecification.description: When the facility can be used, as an OpeningHours value (common subject): weekdays, opening and closing time, remarks

totalMaleToilets.description: Number of toilets in the men's toilet, urinals included (男性トイレ総数)

maleUrinals.description: Number of urinals in the men's toilet (男性トイレ数（小便器）)

maleJapaneseStyleToilets.description: Number of Japanese-style (squat) toilets in the men's toilet (男性トイレ数（和式）)

maleWesternStyleToilets.description: Number of Western-style (sitting) toilets in the men's toilet (男性トイレ数（洋式）)

totalFemaleToilets.description: Number of toilets in the women's toilet (女性トイレ総数)

femaleJapaneseStyleToilets.description: Number of Japanese-style (squat) toilets in the women's toilet (女性トイレ数（和式）)

femaleWesternStyleToilets.description: Number of Western-style (sitting) toilets in the women's toilet (女性トイレ数（洋式）)

totalUnisexToilets.description: Number of all-gender toilets (男女共用トイレ総数)

unisexJapaneseStyleToilets.description: Number of all-gender Japanese-style (squat) toilets (男女共用トイレ数（和式）)

unisexWesternStyleToilets.description: Number of all-gender Western-style (sitting) toilets (男女共用トイレ数（洋式）)

barrierFreeToilets.description: Number of barrier-free toilets: toilets that meet Art. 13(2) of the MLIT barrier-free standard for public transport, or that the municipality defines as multipurpose or barrier-free toilets (バリアフリートイレ数)

wheelchairToilet.description: true when there is a toilet for wheelchair users (車椅子使用者用トイレ有無: 有 → true, 無 → false)

babyCareToilet.description: true when there is a toilet with equipment for babies, such as a baby changing table or seat (乳幼児用設備設置トイレ有無: 有 → true, 無 → false)

ostomateToilet.description: true when there is a toilet for ostomates (オストメイト設置トイレ有無: 有 → true, 無 → false)
